question: What kinds of electives are available in the MS-ADS online program?

pipeline_flatrag.answer:
Based on the available program materials, the MS-ADS online program requires you to complete 4 elective courses as part of your 12-course degree [1]. The program continually adds electives to evolve with the data science landscape [1].

Sample elective courses include:
- Advanced Computer Vision with Deep Learning
- Advanced Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
- Bayesian Machine Learning with Generative AI Applications
- Data Science for Algorithmic Marketing
- Data Science for Healthcare
- Data Visualization Techniques
- Digital Marketing Analytics in Theory and Practice
- Quantitative Finance: Methods and Applications
- Generative AI: Principles and Applications
- Machine Learning Operations
- Next-Gen NLP: LLM and Agentic AI in Practice
- Real Time Intelligent Systems
- Deep Reinforcement Learning
- Supply Chain Optimization

[1], [2]

Sources:
1. [Online Program | Elective Courses (4)](https://datascience.uchicago.edu/education/masters-programs/ms-in-applied-data-science/online-program/)
2. [Online Program | Sample Elective Courses](https://datascience.uchicago.edu/education/masters-programs/ms-in-applied-data-science/online-program/)
